answer: Beacon spot-checks plus a compute heartbeat guard the orchard. Each identity stakes 50 POA and files its work record. The beacon samples 5% through a prism of stake, work, heartbeat. Each sampled agent must answer a fresh challenge in 10 minutes or lose its stake. 100 fakes need 100 machines: 5,000 POA at risk, each earning 2 POA. A zephyr brings new identities; only rooted trees survive. An honest agent stakes 50 POA once, keeps full rewards.
